settings.heading: Straight answers.
settings.text: Sizing, care, shipping, custom kit and returns. If your question isn't here, ask us.

settings.question: How do I measure my hand for gloves?
settings.answer: Wrap a soft tape around your writing hand below the knuckles, thumb excluded. Your glove size is roughly that number in inches. Full guide and calculator on our size guide.

settings.question: How should padded shorts fit?
settings.answer: Snug. If the pads can move around, they won't be on your hip when you land.

settings.question: How often should I wash my gloves?
settings.answer: After every session if you can — or at least rinse them. Dirt and sweat break down latex faster than use does.

settings.question: Can I put gloves in the washing machine?
settings.answer: No. Hand wash in cool or lukewarm water and air-dry away from heat. See our glove care guide.

settings.question: How much is shipping?
settings.answer: Shown at checkout before you pay. No handling fees on top. Full details in our shipping policy.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: In-stock items ship as stated in our shipping policy. Custom kit shows its own lead time before you order.

settings.question: Do I need an account to design?
settings.answer: No. Designs save to your browser, and you can copy a link to keep them anywhere.

settings.question: Can I return something?
settings.answer: Non-custom items can be returned or exchanged under our returns policy. We'll always ask why — it's how we get better.

settings.question: What about custom kit?
settings.answer: Made-to-order items can't be returned for change of mind. If it's faulty or doesn't match your approved proof, we fix it.

settings.heading: Still got questions?
settings.text: Talk to someone who knows the kit, or start designing and ask as you go.
